Method: Remaining = initial × (0.5)^(time / half-life). The units of time and half-life must match (both in years, days, seconds, etc.).

## Kinematics Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/science/kinematic-calculator

Solve SUVAT equations for velocity, acceleration, time, and displacement.

Method: Uses the equations v = u + at and s = ut + ½at² to solve for unknowns. Enter any two values and the tool calculates the rest.

## Z-Score Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/statistics/z-score-calculator

Z-score, percentile, and probability from a value, mean, and standard deviation.

Method: Z = (x − μ) / σ. The z-score measures how many standard deviations a value is from the mean. The percentile is derived from the standard normal cumulative distribution.

## Confidence Interval Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/statistics/confidence-interval-calculator

Confidence interval and margin of error from sample statistics.

Method: CI = mean ± (z × standard error), where standard error = sd / √n. The z-critical value depends on the confidence level (1.96 for 95%).

## Sample Size Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/statistics/sample-size-calculator

Required sample size for a survey at a given confidence and margin of error.

Method: n = (z² × p × (1−p)) / margin². Use p = 50% for the most conservative (largest) sample size when you have no prior estimate of the proportion.

## Correlation Coefficient Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/statistics/correlation-coefficient-calculator

Pearson correlation coefficient (r) and R² from two data lists.

Method: Pearson r measures the linear relationship between two variables, ranging from −1 (perfect negative) to +1 (perfect positive). R² is r squared — the proportion of variance explained.

## P-Value Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/statistics/p-value-calculator

P-value and significance from a z-statistic (one- or two-tailed).

Method: The p-value is the probability of observing a result as extreme as yours if the null hypothesis were true. It is derived from the standard normal distribution based on your z-statistic and test direction.

## CAC Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/business/cac-calculator

Customer Acquisition Cost and LTV:CAC ratio for your marketing spend.

Method: CAC = total sales and marketing spend ÷ new customers acquired. The LTV:CAC ratio divides lifetime value by CAC — a ratio of 3:1 or higher is generally considered healthy.

## Customer Lifetime Value Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/business/customer-lifetime-value-calculator

Customer lifetime value (LTV) from purchase value, frequency, and lifespan.

Method: LTV = average purchase value × purchase frequency × customer lifespan. Applying your gross margin gives the profit-based LTV, which is more meaningful for unit economics.

## ROAS Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/business/roas-calculator

Return on ad spend, net profit, and break-even ROAS.

Method: ROAS = revenue ÷ ad spend, expressed as a ratio. Break-even ROAS accounts for product cost (COGS): you need revenue to cover both ad spend and the cost of goods sold.

## Email Marketing ROI Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/business/email-marketing-roi-calculator

Projected revenue and ROI from an email campaign funnel.

Method: Revenue = list × open rate × click rate × conversion rate × average order value. ROI = (revenue − cost) ÷ cost. Email consistently delivers one of the highest ROIs in marketing.

## Employee Turnover Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/business/employee-turnover-calculator

Turnover rate and estimated replacement cost for your team.

Method: Turnover rate = (employees who left ÷ average headcount) × 100. Replacement cost is estimated at roughly 50% of annual salary, covering recruiting, onboarding, and lost productivity.

## Gross Margin Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/business/gross-margin-calculator

Gross margin, gross profit, and markup from revenue and cost.

Method: Gross margin = (revenue − COGS) ÷ revenue. Markup = (revenue − COGS) ÷ COGS. They describe the same profit but from different bases, which is why they differ.

## Dollar-Cost Averaging Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/investing/dollar-cost-averaging-calculator

Projected portfolio value from regular monthly investments.

Method: Each monthly contribution compounds at the monthly equivalent of your annual return. The future value uses the annuity formula, summing all contributions plus their compounded growth.

## Crypto Profit/Loss Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/investing/crypto-profit-loss-calculator

Profit or loss on a crypto trade, including fees.

Method: Profit = (sell price × quantity) − fees − (buy price × quantity). Fees are applied to the gross sale proceeds. The result shows both dollar P&L and percentage return.

## Stock Return Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/investing/stock-return-calculator

Total and annualized return on a stock investment, including dividends.

Method: Total return = capital gain + dividends, as a percent of cost. Annualized return (CAGR) converts the total return into an equivalent compounded yearly rate over your holding period.

## Dividend Yield Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/investing/dividend-yield-calculator

Dividend yield and annual income from a dividend stock.

Method: Dividend yield = (annual dividend per share ÷ share price) × 100. As price rises, yield falls; as price falls, yield rises (assuming the dividend is held constant).

## P/E Ratio Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/investing/pe-ratio-calculator

Price-to-earnings ratio and earnings yield for a stock.

Method: P/E = share price ÷ earnings per share. Earnings yield is the inverse (EPS ÷ price), showing earnings as a percentage of price — useful for comparing to bond yields.

## Paycheck Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/tax/paycheck-calculator

Estimate take-home pay after federal tax, FICA, state tax, and 401(k).

Method: Federal tax uses 2026 bracket tables and the standard deduction. FICA is 6.2% Social Security (up to the wage base) plus 1.45% Medicare. State tax and 401(k) use the rates you enter.

## VAT Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/tax/vat-calculator

Add or remove VAT at any rate, with the tax amount broken out.

Method: To add VAT: gross = net × (1 + rate). To remove VAT: net = gross ÷ (1 + rate). The VAT amount is the difference between gross and net.

## Self-Employment Tax Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/tax/self-employment-tax-calculator

Estimate US self-employment (SECA) tax on your net business profit.

Method: SE tax is 15.3% on 92.35% of net profit — 12.4% Social Security (up to the wage base) plus 2.9% Medicare. Half of the SE tax is deductible against your income tax.

## Fuel Cost Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/finance/fuel-cost-calculator

Estimate trip fuel cost from distance, MPG/L/100km, and fuel price.

Method: US: gallons = miles ÷ MPG; cost = gallons × price. Metric: liters = (km ÷ 100) × L/100km; cost = liters × price.

## Circle Area Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/math/circle-area-calculator

Area and circumference of a circle from its radius.

Method: Uses the mathematical constant π ≈ 3.14159. Diameter = 2 × radius.

## Concrete Volume Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/construction/concrete-volume-calculator

Calculate concrete volume for slabs, footings, and columns.

Method: Volume = length × width × thickness. Convert cubic feet to cubic yards by dividing by 27.

## Electricity Bill Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/finance/electricity-bill-calculator

Estimate monthly electricity cost from kWh usage and rate.

Method: Bill = kWh × rate. Many utilities also add fixed fees — add those separately if needed.

## Calorie Deficit Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/health/calorie-deficit-calculator

How many calories to cut for a target weekly weight loss.

Method: 1 kg of fat ≈ 7700 kcal. Daily deficit = (target kg × 7700) ÷ 7. Then calories to eat = TDEE − deficit.

## Waist-to-Height Ratio Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/health/waist-to-height-ratio-calculator

Waist-to-height ratio as a simple health risk indicator.

Method: WHtR = waist ÷ height. Both measurements should be in the same unit.

## Military Time Converter

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/date-time/military-time-converter

Convert between 12-hour and 24-hour (military) time.

Method: 24-hour time runs from 00:00 to 23:59. 00:00 is midnight, 12:00 is noon, 13:00 is 1 PM, etc.

## Pregnancy Week Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/health/pregnancy-week-calculator

Current pregnancy week and trimester from last period.

Method: Gestational age starts from LMP. A full term pregnancy is about 40 weeks. Trimesters are roughly weeks 1–12, 13–26, and 27–40.

## Rectangle Area Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/math/rectangle-area-calculator

Area and perimeter of a rectangle from length and width.

Method: Simple multiplication and addition. Works for any units as long as length and width use the same unit.

## Download Time Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/developer/download-time-calculator

Estimate how long a file takes to download or upload from its size and transfer speed.

Method: Transfer time in seconds equals file size in bits divided by transfer speed in bits per second. A byte contains 8 bits, so 100 Mbps equals 12.5 MB/s. GB uses powers of 1,000 and GiB uses powers of 1,024.

## Pixel Density (PPI) Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/image/ppi-calculator

Calculate screen pixels per inch, pixel pitch, and physical dimensions from resolution and diagonal.

Method: With square pixels, the pixel diagonal equals the square root of width² + height². Divide it by the physical diagonal in inches for PPI. Pixel pitch in millimeters equals 25.4 divided by PPI.

## Battery Life Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/science/battery-life-calculator

Estimate battery runtime in hours and days from capacity in mAh and average current in mA.

Method: Estimated runtime in hours equals capacity in mAh × usable percentage ÷ 100 ÷ average battery-side current in mA. The result is a charge-budget estimate. Age, temperature, voltage cutoffs, and discharge rate affect usable capacity.

## Canada GST/HST Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/tax/canada-gst-hst-calculator

Add or reverse Canadian GST or HST using the province or territory of supply.

Method: Multiply the pre-tax amount by the GST/HST rate to add tax. To reverse a tax-inclusive amount, divide it by one plus the rate. Only enter a total that includes GST/HST alone for the reverse calculation.

## US Business Mileage Calculator 2026

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/tax/us-mileage-calculator-2026

Estimate the 2026 IRS business mileage amount using separate rates for each half of the year.

Method: Multiply January through June business miles by $0.725 and July through December business miles by $0.76, then add the two amounts.

## EMI Calculator (India)

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/finance/emi-calculator

Calculate a fixed-rate loan EMI in rupees with total interest and repayment.

Method: EMI = P × r / (1 − (1+r)^−n), using monthly decimal rate r and number of months n. At 0%, EMI is principal divided by months. Fees and floating-rate resets are excluded.

## SIP Calculator (India)

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/investing/sip-calculator

Project monthly SIP contributions in rupees using an assumed return and contribution timing.

Method: The future value of monthly deposits is C × ((1+r)^n − 1) / r. Beginning-of-month deposits multiply this by (1+r). Return is an assumption, not a mutual-fund forecast; taxes and charges are excluded.

## GST Calculator (India)

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/tax/india-gst-calculator

Add or reverse Indian GST and split tax into IGST or CGST plus SGST/UTGST.

Method: Add GST as base × rate. Reverse an inclusive price by dividing by 1 + rate. Interstate mode shows IGST; intrastate mode splits the arithmetic equally. Select the rate applicable to the supply; this tool does not determine classification or place of supply.

## PPF Calculator — Annual Projection

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/finance/ppf-calculator

Project a PPF-style annual savings balance using an assumed interest rate and annual contribution.

Method: The model deposits the annual contribution at the start of each modeled year and compounds yearly at a constant assumed rate. Actual PPF interest uses monthly qualifying balances, credited yearly, and rates can change quarterly. This is not an account statement or exact maturity-date calculation.

## FD Calculator — Deposit Maturity

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/finance/fd-calculator

Estimate fixed-deposit maturity and interest before tax using an assumed compounding frequency.

Method: Maturity = principal × (1 + annual rate / compounding frequency)^(frequency × years). This models a cumulative deposit without withdrawals. Bank day counts, payout options, premature closure and TDS can differ.

## RD Calculator — Monthly Deposits

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/finance/rd-calculator

Estimate recurring-deposit maturity from equal monthly deposits and quarterly-compounding assumptions.

Method: Each monthly installment is assumed to arrive at the beginning of the month. The equivalent monthly growth factor is (1 + annual rate/4)^(1/3). Bank day-count conventions, delays, tax and penalties are excluded.

## EPF Calculator — Balance Projection

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/finance/epf-calculator

Project an EPF balance from actual employee and employer EPF deposits, excluding EPS.

Method: Monthly deposits are held constant. Estimated monthly interest accrues on the balance before that month’s contribution and is added annually. Enter only the employer amount credited to EPF, not its separate EPS allocation. Rates, wages and contributions are assumptions; compare the passbook for actual credits.

## Gratuity Calculator — Formula Estimate

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/finance/gratuity-calculator

Apply the 15/26 gratuity formula to eligible monthly wages and counted service years.

Method: The illustration uses eligible monthly wages × 15 / 26 × counted service years. Extra service strictly greater than six months rounds up. This does not determine legal eligibility, wage components, statutory ceiling, fixed-term treatment or tax exemption. Current labour-code rules and employment terms require separate review.

## HRA Calculator — Old-Regime Exemption

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/tax/hra-calculator

Estimate an eligible old-regime HRA exemption using matching-period salary, rent and HRA.

Method: Exemption is the nonnegative minimum of actual HRA, rent minus 10% of Rule 2A salary, and 50% of that salary in qualifying metro cities or 40% elsewhere. Use the same period for every input. Salary definitions, evidence and regime eligibility must be confirmed separately.

## India Income Tax Calculator — AY 2026–27

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/tax/india-income-tax-calculator

Compare AY 2026–27 old and new regime tax on ordinary taxable income up to ₹50 lakh.

Method: For resident individuals below 60 only. Enter taxable income after deductions, not gross salary. The comparison applies each regime’s slab rates, 87A rebate, new-regime marginal relief near ₹12 lakh and 4% cess. Income and final tax are rounded to ₹10. Surcharge, capital gains, special rates, agricultural income and other relief are excluded. Run each regime separately with its own taxable income when deductions differ.

## Compress PDF — Local Optimization

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/pdf/compress-pdf

Repack PDF objects locally and keep the smaller file without resampling images.

Method: The tool rewrites supported PDFs with compressed object streams, then compares byte sizes. If the output is not smaller, the original file is offered. This does not downsample scans or guarantee a reduction. Rewriting may invalidate signatures; inspect forms, bookmarks and structure.

## HEIC to JPG Converter

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/image/heic-to-jpg

Convert supported HEIC or HEIF images to JPEG locally without uploading files.

Method: A browser decoder reads supported HEIC/HEIF frames and encodes JPEG at 90% quality. EXIF, HDR, depth and live-photo metadata are not preserved. Unsupported codec variants may fail. JPEG is lossy.

## Random Number Generator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/math/random-number-generator

Generate a random integer between inclusive bounds using browser cryptographic randomness.

Method: Rejection sampling maps 32-bit cryptographic values uniformly to the selected interval. Bounds must be safe integers and span at most 2³² possible values. This is not a certified gaming or lottery service.

## Coin Flip

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/math/coin-flip

Flip a virtual coin with browser cryptographic randomness.

Method: An unbiased random integer selects heads or tails. Draws are independent; previous results do not make the next outcome more likely.

## Random Name Picker

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/math/random-name-picker

Pick a random nonempty line from a locally entered list of names.

Method: Every nonempty trimmed line is one equally likely entry. Duplicate names receive multiple entries. The list remains in the browser; this is not a certified prize-drawing service.

## Typing Speed Test

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/text/typing-speed-test

Practice typing for up to 60 seconds and see correct WPM and current text accuracy.

Method: The timer starts on the first input. Correctly matched characters divided by five and elapsed minutes gives correct WPM. Accuracy compares current text positions, so edits can correct earlier errors. Pasting is disabled for practice.

## PDF Editor & Viewer

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/pdf/pdf-editor

Open the complete PdfCraft PDF workspace: view, annotate, organize, fill forms and recognize scanned text locally.

Method: Open the independently hosted PdfCraft workspace on this website. Choose your PDF, use its editing or document tools, and save the result. The editor and its local OCR assets are loaded only when opened.
